verdict.rationale: Crossmint lets developers pay against open machine-payment protocols, x402 and MPP, through standard protocol clients (@x402/core, mppx). Its agent checkout API carries a version label ("v1"), and the API reference can be exercised live in the browser. However, no OpenAPI/schema file was found at the probed standard paths, and nothing documents a published, versioned commerce-protocol schema or conformance tooling. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable schema or protocol spec, explicit protocol versioning policy, conformance/validation test tooling, independent corroboration.
